LanguageData.RT_M10_MainBattleTank.label: M10 Booker
LanguageData.RT_M10_MainBattleTank.description:
US Mobile Protected Firepower combat vehicle armed with a 105mm M35 rifled cannon, .50 Cal M2 Browning, and coaxial M240.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Loader x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 105mm M35 Cannon: 105x617mmR NATO (HE / HESH / APFSDS) - .50 Cal M2 Browning: .50 BMG cartridge (FMJ / AP / Incendiary / Sabot) - 7.62mm M240 MG: 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
